Two pipeline additions you can use (both additive). (1) common/plates._expand_hi now drops its highlight knee from p95 to p80/65/50 when a flat pale surface fills the subject's top 5 %; a card stuck at luma ~199 needs no light changes. Two additive pipeline features you can use. (1) A CARDS splash entry can set "box_top": <m>. It caps the fitted box's top so a raised weapon leaves the frame and the body fills the card (art/blender/common/render.py). (2) A CARDS plate entry can set "sub_median": N. It runs N 3x3 median passes on the subject before the paint-over, which clears single-pixel texture speckle that keeps card_qa above 2.5 (art/blender/common/plates.py median3). You can test it without Blender: `python3 art/blender/common/plates.py compose <sid> [--kind splash]`. Also, art/tools/decimate_chains.mjs now has --normal-q N. Do not thin a one-shot clip whose keys the optimizer already made irregular (death): it broke the floor gate.
